parameters.name: BeginTime
parameters.description:
The start of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
If you specify `TaskId` to retrieve more pages, this parameter is ignored. The start time from the first query is used.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to return. Pages start from 1. The value can be up to 50 and must not exceed the total number of pages.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
If you specify `TaskId` to retrieve more pages, this parameter is ignored. The end time from the first query is used.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the consumer group to query.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance that contains the message.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of messages to return on each page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 5. Maximum value: 50.
If you specify `TaskId` to retrieve more pages, this parameter is ignored. The page size from the first query is used.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the query task. Omit this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the task ID returned by the previous query.
